Oh no no but I got, I had a picture of the band but by transferring it from book to book I had toys you see. Yeah. Yeah.

Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. That's a good picture. Yeah. That's a nice picture. Is this taking preservation? Yeah. Yeah. I made that three months ago just before we went to Memphis. Yeah.
